text: marie: Noticed inconsistency — the help pill on Model details says "Docs" but the top-level Console nav uses "Developer Docs". Can we pick one? Also the pill opens a right-side inline preview for some models and a new tab for others depending on the upstream link. That's confusing. kevin: Oof. Sounds like a cross-linking problem and missing affordance. I think we should standardize the label to "Developer docs" across console. Inline preview when available is great, but if we open a new tab we must visually and semantically indicate that. emma: UX: agree on "Developer docs". For the inline preview (sidecar) we need clear close control, focus trap, and focus return to the pill. If we load external content, keep it in an iframe sandboxed, or fall back to new tab. pri: Quick a11y note: if we open a sidecar we need role="dialog" and aria-modal=true. For links that open new tabs: include aria-describedby pointing to a hidden span that says "opens in new tab". Example: Developer docs opens in a new tab ben: From infra: we only host previews for docs under `/docs/*`. Anything that redirects outside our domain should open new tab. We can add a header on the preview that shows the canonical docs URL and an "Open full docs" link. Also recommend a feature flag `product.ui.docs_sidecar_enabled` so we can roll out. marie: Good. Can we also align terminology in the docs pages? Some pages say "Console docs" and others "In-product help". We should standardize copy and the cross-link text. kevin: Proposal for microcopy options (choose one): 1) Button label: "Developer docs" — Secondary text (subtitle): "Opens docs in side panel" or "Opens docs in new tab" depending on flow. 2) Button label: "Help & docs" — Subtitle: "Learn about this page". emma: I prefer option 1, it's clearer. Keep the subtitle short; screen readers will get the aria text. pri: Implementation details: add `aria-live="polite"` announcements when sidecar loads content ("Docs preview loaded"). Ensure keyboard: Tab into sidecar goes to close button first. Escape closes. Focus returns to the originating pill. ben: I'll add the feature flag and a small LRU cache for rendered previews. We should also instrument metrics: preview_open, preview_failed, preview_open_external. marie: Action items: - pri: write the a11y checklist + code snippets + tests - kevin: update copy across Console and nav (PR to console repo) - ben: feature flag + metrics + fallback behavior - emma: design the sidecar header and close behavior (compact) accessibility-bot: Created accessibility ticket AC-482: Sidecar focus management + external-link hints. docs-bot: Created PR #242 in console repo: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/242 — standardize "Developer docs" label. marie: Thanks team. Let's aim for a small rollout behind the flag and a short note in release notes about the new behavior.
